text.europe: Hundreds of thousands march across France over schools and policing, and police arrest almost 1,000 people and charge a crowd in Paris. Thomas Markle Sr denies possessing child abuse images, Palestinians fear Israel's election, and Andy Burnham wants an honest discussion with the EU on freedom of movement.
text.international: Palestinians fear the worst from Israel's election, as Gadi Eisenkot and Benjamin Netanyahu vow to end Hamas rule while Gaza's humanitarian catastrophe goes largely ignored.
